## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
install.packages('ggridges')
install.packages('patchwork')
BiocManager::install('limma')
install.packages("BiocManager")
library(ggplot2)
library(ggridges)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)
library(limma)
library(matrixStats)

```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r}
gtex_lung_B1_tpm <- as.matrix(read.csv("../outputs/tables/GTEx_lung_B1_tpm.csv", 
                                       row.names = 1))
gtex_lung_C1_tpm <- as.matrix(read.csv("../outputs/tables/GTEx_lung_C1_tpm.csv", 
                                       row.names = 1))
mab <- read.csv("../outputs/tables/MindAndBody_compiled.csv", 
                stringsAsFactors = T, row.names=1)
```


```{r}
dim(gtex_lung_C1_tpm)
dim(gtex_lung_B1_tpm)

all(rownames(gtex_lung_B1_tpm) %in%(gtex_lung_C1_tpm))
all(rownames(gtex_lung_B1_tpm) == rownames(gtex_lung_C1_tpm))
```

Re-order C1 and integrate
```{r}
gtex_lung_C1_tpm = gtex_lung_C1_tpm[rownames(gtex_lung_B1_tpm), ]
all(rownames(gtex_lung_B1_tpm) == rownames(gtex_lung_C1_tpm))
gtex_lung_TPM = cbind(gtex_lung_B1_tpm, gtex_lung_C1_tpm)
dim(gtex_lung_TPM)
```


```{r}
qplot(rowMeans(gtex_lung_TPM), rowVars(gtex_lung_TPM))
qplot(rowMeans(log1p(gtex_lung_TPM)), rowVars(log1p(gtex_lung_TPM)))
gtex_logTPM_scaled = t(scale(t(gtex_lung_TPM)))
```

```{r}
gtex_logtpm <- log1p(gtex_lung_TPM)
plot(rowMeans(gtex_logtpm), rowSds(gtex_logtpm))
sampled_genes <- sample(rownames(gtex_logtpm), 20)

boxplot(t(gtex_logtpm[sampled_genes,]))
pca = prcomp(t(gtex_lung_TPM))
```

```{r}
plot_pca <- function(x){
  x <- log1p(x)    # variance stabilisation
  hvg <- names(head(sort(rowSds(x), decreasing = T), 500))  # get top 5000 variable genes
  pca <- prcomp(t(x[hvg,]),scale. = T)   # perform PCA transformation
  qplot(x=PC1, y=PC2, colour = batch, data = pca$x)  # plot first 2 embeddings
}

batch = rep(c('B1', 'C1'), each=30)

plot_pca(gtex_lung_TPM)
```
Clear difference between batches
Regression needed to remove this effect
Limma package performs this in one step

```{r}
gtex_lung_TPM_regressed = removeBatchEffect(gtex_lung_TPM, batch = batch)
plot_pca(gtex_lung_TPM_regressed)
```

```{r}
View(mab)
```


```{r}
ggplot(mab,mapping = aes(x=awakenings, y=nr_of_shifts)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = dreem_record_endpoints_version),
             size = 2.5)+
               labs(x='Awakening scores', y= 'Number of shifts', color ='Version') +
  ggtitle('Scatterplot of awakenings vs sleep shifts')+
  scale_color_manual(values = c('cornflowerblue','indianred'))+
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 10), 
        axis.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "bottom")+
geom_smooth(method = 'lm', color='black')
```

Single continuous variable
```{r}
ggplot(data = mab, mapping = aes(x=rem_duration)) +
  geom_density()
ggplot(data = mab, mapping = aes(x=rem_duration)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50)
```


```{r}
ggplot(data = mab, mapping= aes(x=device, y = average_respiration_rate)) +

ggplot(data = mab, mapping= aes(x=device, y = average_respiration_rate)) +
  geom_boxplot()
ggplot(data = mab, mapping= aes(x=device, y = average_respiration_rate)) +
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = mab, mapping= aes(x = average_respiration_rate, y=device)) +

```


```{r}
ggplot(mab, mapping = aes(x=device, y=average_respiration_rate))+
  geom_bar(stat='identity') +
  stat_summary(geom='errorbar', width = 0.2)
```

```{r}
ggplot(mab, aes(x=dreem_record_endpoints_version, 
                y = average_respiration_rate)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  stat_compare_means()
```

```{r}
ggplot(mab, aes(x=device, y = average_respiration_rate)) +
  geom_boxplot() +

                             comparisons = list(c("a1c74e45-5ec4-4bd5-98f4-d75242f4f524",

                                                c("2240fe9f-00fe-4dc2-8017-f2bb8f41f547",
```
